newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures flat in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures flat in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were flat in all months on Thursday in extremely thin after-hours trade with little activity detected, traders said on Thursday.
All months were unchanged from the day's close. Benchmark April was flat at 140.5 yen.

During the day, short-covering in distant months helped prices rebound from early lows. "Activity was sluggish, as private investors were shifting money to more volatile cotton futures," one trader said. "Prices could drift sideways until the release of Japan rubber stocks on next Monday," he said.
